title: VIX futures and options December 2027 expiration (SOQ settlement) — the settlement whose published date this repo has twice derived as wrong
source: EST: CBOE'S OWN SETTLEMENT RULE APPLIED FORWARD AND RE-DERIVED IN-SESSION 2026-09-08, DELIBERATELY AGAINST THE PUBLISHER'S OWN ROW. The rule -- 'the Wednesday that is 30 days prior to the third Friday of the calendar month immediately following the month in which the contract expires', with settlement moving to the immediately preceding business day if either that Wednesday or the Friday 30 days after it is a Cboe Options holiday -- is quoted verbatim in this repo's vix-expiration-2027-10-20 entry from a cboe.com fetch that resolved it on 2026-09-06. THIS SESSION COULD NOT RE-READ THE RULE TEXT ITSELF: cboe.com/tradable_products/vix/vix_futures/specifications/ returned HTTP 200 (461,361 bytes) but its specification table renders client-side and the 'Final Settlement Date' body was absent from the served HTML, so the rule is cited from the sibling ledger rather than claimed as read here (recorded in the proposer's probe-ref.blocked). APPLIED TO THE DECEMBER 2027 CONTRACT: January 2028's Fridays are the 7th, 14th, 21st and 28th, so the third Friday is 2028-01-21; the Wednesday 30 days prior is 2027-12-22; neither leg is a holiday (MLK Day 2028 is Monday 2028-01-17, and OCC's published 2027 holiday set carries nothing between 2027-11-25 and 2027-12-24). The clause does not fire and settlement stands on Wednesday 2027-12-22. THE PUBLISHER DISAGREES AND IS INTERNALLY INCONSISTENT, WHICH IS THE WHOLE REASON THIS PROPOSAL EXISTS. The OIC/OCC calendar at www.optionseducation.org/api/expirationcalendar (HTTP 200, 34,871 bytes, re-fetched this session) carries its December 2027 'Monthly Volatility Products Expiration date' on 2027-12-15. That is off by a week by the publisher's own standard: 2027-12-15 plus 30 days is 2028-01-14, the SECOND Friday of January 2028. This session coded the full rule, holiday clause included, and scored the payload's volatility-products series 35 of 36 across 2025-01 to 2027-12 -- the sole disagreement being 2027-12. That INDEPENDENTLY REPRODUCES the finding vix-expiration-2027-10-20 recorded on 2026-09-06 from a different direction, and it is the only month in three years where the publisher breaks its own rule. By contrast the payload's MONTHLY EQUITY series scores 36 of 36 against an independent third-Friday rule, which is why opex-2027-12-17 promoted to confirmed and this proposal does not. Discovered during the opex-2027-12-17 initial research, checked 2026-09-08
notes: PROPOSED by the opex-2027-12-17 initial research (2026-09-08) because it is a dated event inside the proposer's +/-5-day corridor (D+5) that this calendar does not hold in any form -- canonical or proposed. The calendar's vix-expiration class stops at vix-expiration-2027-10-20, so December 2027 has no settlement entry at all. THE DATE IS THE CONTESTED PART AND A TAKING LANE MUST NOT RESOLVE IT BY PICKING THE EASIER SOURCE. Two candidate dates exist: 2027-12-22 (Cboe's own rule, which the publisher's other 35 of 36 rows obey) and 2027-12-15 (the publisher's December 2027 row, which is inconsistent with that rule and which two independent sessions in this repo have now derived as wrong). This proposal files the RULE-DERIVED date because a rule a publisher obeys 35 times and breaks once is better evidence than the once. It is filed estimate, not confirmed, on three counts: no Cboe settlement or expiration-calendar primary was successfully read for 2027-12 this session; the December 2027 contract (VX/Z7) has not been checked against Cboe's settlement surface, which vix-expiration-2027-10-20 established as the promotion trigger for this class and which stopped at VX/K7 2027-05-18 as of 2026-09-04; and a discovering sweep may not self-confirm. PROMOTION TRIGGER, inherited from the sibling: VX/Z7 appearing on a Cboe settlement or expiration-calendar surface dated 2027-12-22. IF IT APPEARS DATED 2027-12-15 INSTEAD, this proposal is wrong and should be replaced rather than argued with -- the publisher would then be the venue's own record and the rule derivation the error. THE PROPOSER STATES ITS INTEREST AND DISCLAIMS THE INFERENCE: opex-2027-12-17 measured December quarterly expirations inert against the other three quarterly months on every channel (VIX P = 0.198, |S&P| P = 0.693, forward realized vol P = 0.372), so nothing about a nearby VIX settlement is claimed to matter, and vix-expiration-2027-10-20 already measured the in-blackout and pre-decision settlement configurations inert on four channels each. This is a calendar-completeness fix and a recorded source conflict, not a signal. Proposed as an estimate; nothing here licenses an entry.
